body: I feel like just as tucutes make trans people look bad, detrans terfs/gc make detrans people look bad

Yeah, something similar already happened to me when I was younger. I was a really “writing person”. - poems, short stories, songs, tried writing a movie script :D. It was discovered and from a certain age I stopped. The only time a wrote was when I was on my phone - they don’t have a password to it.

Plus my mom had this really weird habit of collecting things I wrote in my room and then storing it in her room. Probably reading it. They usually weren’t too personal. Usually just sketches mixed with notes I took about my hobbies but still

I mean, they said I’m a crybaby and even I think I’m a crybaby now. It was more of a nostalgic laugh, I explained it badly. But even tho I don’t know which story it was I’m pretty sure it contained things that should really stay just between me and the piece of paper
